title: Nourishing Earthy Venezuelan Haggis Skewers
description: A traditional Venezuelan dish featuring haggis, robata-grilled to perfection, perfect for a hangover cure, this recipe is sugar-free-friendly and packed with earthy flavors. The combination of haggis, vegetables, and spices creates a gooey and savory experience.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the haggis, red bell pepper, onion, mushrooms, and zucchini onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the haggis is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a side of your favorite sauce.
Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
To ensure food safety, cook the haggis to an internal temperature of at least 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
Use a food thermometer to check the internal temperature of the haggis.
